sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Developer Infrastructure, Database and API Monitoring Cloud

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Law influences, with customary law; independent legal system based on the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu 1980)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus Trade Agreement (2017, with Australia and New Zealand)
Investment Promotion and Facilitation Act No. 34 of 1998
Pacific Islands Forum and Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) framework
Exchange of Information Article under the Vanuatu- Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2010)
Vanuatu- New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 35 of 2016 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap. 222], particularly sections on registered agent duties, registers, and disclosure to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); Financial Dealers Licensing Act No. 20 of 1999; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 35 of 1993; Companies (Amendment) Act No. 6 of 2012; and the VFSC Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Rulebooks issued under the VFIU.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and each significant shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; authentication must proceed via the Vanuatu diplomatic or consular mission)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference and financial due diligence letter from the customer's account-holding bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding licensed bank in the country of origin or a recognized correspondent bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate UBO or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized company registry in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Register of directors and register of shareholders or certificate of incumbency for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent or corporate secretary in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds sworn affidavit, executed by each UBO, covering the proposed funding for the Vanuatu International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and beneficial owners against the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) List, HM Treasury UK Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic list of designated persons maintained by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory where any person is a politically exposed person (PEP), a family member or close associate of a PEP, or where the country-of-origin is on FATF or Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) high-risk or monitored lists. Risk-based perpetual sanctions screening of the legal entity and its UBOs must be performed at least annually and in connection with any material change in beneficial ownership.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry – Name Reservation and Clearance e-Service (accessible via www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names of International Companies may be registered in English or French, or in another language if a Roman-script transliteration is provided and approved. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name or protected name. Statutory suffixes are limited to 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'S.A.', 'Ltd.', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', or such other suffix recognized by the VFSC. The local script requirement does not mandate any indigenous language; however the VFSC requires all submissions and communications to be in English or French.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or the licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the VFSC Registry Manager within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must set out the proposed name, the grounds for refusal, and submissions demonstrating non-identicalness and non-deceptiveness, together with any supporting trademark or goodwill evidence. The VFSC shall respond within 10 business days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may submit a fresh name reservation application with a different name. A further administrative reconsideration may be addressed to the Minister responsible for financial services under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], subject to payment of the prescribed appeal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not permitted to satisfy the statutory registered office requirement. An International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the address of its licensed registered agent. The registered office may be used solely for service of process and statutory communications; the company may operate as a 'pure offshore' entity without a physical operational office, data center, or local employees in Vanuatu, provided it does not carry on business with Vatu or with Vanuatu residents. For the target business of developer infrastructure, database, and API monitoring cloud services, virtual administrative back-office functions may be contracted freely, but the statutory registered address must remain a physical Vanuatu address held by the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk. For a Low_Risk_Standard international company with no onshore activities and no statutory license requirement, the VFSC's risk-based supervision framework indicates an approximate 5% to 10% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection of the registered office, predominantly through the licensed registered agent rather than the company's own premises. The probability increases toward 15% if the company maintains a physical server or cloud node in Vanuatu or if its banking relationships trigger a regulator-flagged risk event.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations [Cap. 222]

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent service fee for first year (including register maintenance and statutory filings)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; quoted per International Company per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per International Company formation package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended (Cap 222), Sections 6 (Incorporation), 10 (Memorandum and Articles), 14 (Certificate of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber, accompanied by Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital. The sole subscriber may subscribe for one or more shares with no escrow or deposit requirement; share capital may be denominated in any major currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (i) That the subscriber’s share subscription herein is accepted and one ordinary share be issued to the initial subscriber. (ii) That the registered office of the Company be established at the business address of the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as filed with the Registrar. (iii) That the undersigned director(s) accept office as the first director(s). (iv) That the directors appoint a Secretary and, where required, a Resident Agent. (v) That the directors open bank accounts and execute all instruments necessary to activate the Company’s operations, subject to the provisions of the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to prepare and file the Memorandum and Articles of Association. All subscribers and initial directors must execute the documents. The registered agent will certify compliance with the International Companies Act and submit the package via the VFSC online portal or in-person at the Companies Registry counter.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the subscriber's passport (for natural person) or certificate of incorporation (for corporate subscriber)
Memorandum and Articles of Association, executed and witnessed
Form IC-01 signed by the registered agent and subscriber
Registered office address confirmation letter from the licensed agent
Consent to act as first director(s) and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query or rejection, the registered agent must correct the defect within 14 days; if the application is refused, a fresh application may be filed after rectifying the issue, or the applicant may request written reasons and seek judicial review under the Companies (Prescribed Forms and Fees) Regulations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Form IC-01 together with the constitutional documents through the authorized registered agent. Pay the prescribed government filing fee of USD 250 via agent’s escrow or direct transfer to the VFSC’s official bank account. Retain the receipt as proof of filing.
required_dossiers: Agent’s cover letter with approval to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment fails or is underpaid, the VFSC will request the balance within 5 business days; failure to comply leads to deemed withdrawal. Remedy by submitting amended payment and resubmitting the file in a first-to-file queue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Registration Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent then files the company details in the VFSC’s internal register, prepares the Company seal (if desired), and issues certified copies of the certificate, memorandum, articles, and register of directors and shareholders to the company.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Statutory registers (directors, members, charges) prepared by agent
Registered agent’s compliance checklist and due diligence file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate erroneously reflects incorrect company name or date, file a rectification request with the VFSC registrar under Section 12 of the International Companies Act; the registrar will correct the record within 10 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no physical industrial presence; pure software/cloud infrastructure service.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required (no local trading or manufacturing activity; International Company is prohibited from carrying on business in Vanuatu except as specifically permitted under the International Companies Act)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Energy, Water and Ports (MCCEWP)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – digital software development and cloud monitoring infrastructure produce no point-source emissions or physical discharge; no EIA required under the Environmental Impact Assessment (Amendment) Act 2020
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. No wastewater, VOCs, or solid waste generated. Server activities are either cloud-hosted externally or subject to hosting provider’s environmental compliance; if any local office is established, general refuse disposal must comply with Port Vila Municipal Ordinance and DEPC waste management guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for offshore digital entity. If a physical registered office is set up, a local business license with no trade endorsement is obtained through Port Vila Municipal Council; fire safety and building occupancy certificates are only required for a physical office, which the International Company may not maintain unless separately authorized. The registered agent provides the address for service, which does not require occupational clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Service (VRCS), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — Portal: https://www.vrcs.vu; corporate registry and offshore licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Portal: https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No income tax TIN is required for a Vanuatu International Company (International Companies Act Cap 222). Incorporation is effected exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC registry number constitute the sole statutory identifiers. VAT registration at VRCS applies only where the IC carries on any taxable supply inside Vanuatu, which is statutorily prohibited for ICs; an IC may nonetheless apply for voluntary VAT registration to invoice zero-rated offshore supplies while maintaining a VRCS tax invoice numbering sequence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, CFC, hybrid mismatch, or territorial election mechanisms exist under Vanuatu law. The IC is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on offshore income and capital gains (International Companies Act Cap 222, s. 40); the exemption is automatic, non-elective, indefinite, and cannot be waived by taxpayer action.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 in taxable turnover during any 12-month period (VAT Act No. 24 of 2022, s. 6); voluntary registration permitted after the first taxable supply
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or B2B clearance mandate is currently operative; VAT-registered sellers must issue serial-numbered VAT tax invoices within 7 days of supply, and VRCS accepts voluntary software-based e-invoicing (XML/Peppol-style UBL) without pre-clearance or digital fiscal stamp.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods qualify for 0% VAT where the goods physically leave Vanuatu within 28 days of supply and the exporter retains a customs export declaration and transport document; offshore services qualify for 0% where supplied to a non-resident outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and the effective use and enjoyment of the service occurs outside Vanuatu. For the IC structure, offshore cloud infrastructure, database, and API monitoring services for foreign clients fall entirely outside the Vanuatu VAT net as non-taxable offshore supplies; where the IC voluntarily registers, such supplies are zero-rated rather than exempt, allowing input credit recovery.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (VRCS Customs electronic CUSDEC entry)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 statement evidencing settlement from the non-resident buyer
Signed Offshore Service Contract containing place-of-supply, use-and-enjoyment, and non-resident status clauses
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No exchange control or mandatory FX repatriation deadline exists in Vanuatu (Exchange Control Act repealed 1993). VRCS may scrutinize zero-rating substantiation for up to 5 years; fraudulent or reckless claims trigger refund clawback with interest at 25%, civil fines up to VT 10,000,000, imprisonment up to 10 years (VAT Act 2022, ss. 94-99), and registered-agent disqualification; deliberate misuse of an IC for tax fraud additionally exposes the entity to VFSC deregistration and a 20-year statutory bar on reincorporation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125]; acts as the central monetary authority, prudential regulator for licensed financial institutions, and the de facto foreign exchange administration in the Republic of Vanuatu.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised capital and current account regime; there are no general exchange-control restrictions on payments or transfers. The VUV is not a globally deliverable hard currency, and market convertibility is supported by authorised foreign-exchange dealers. Profit remittances and capital repatriation may be conducted freely, subject only to standard anti-money laundering (AML), taxation clearance, and beneficial-ownership verification. No separate capital-control permit is required for dividend or capital repayment flows to foreign shareholders.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory obligation to surrender export proceeds to the central bank and no minimum mandatory conversion ratio into VUV. Exporters may hold foreign-currency receipts in licensed bank accounts. Periodic trade and balance-of-payments reporting to the Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics and the RBV is required for statistical aggregation, but repatriation timelines do not bind the International Company structure.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-to-Low. Unlicensed foreign fintech electronic-money institutions (EMIs) and digital payment service providers cannot lawfully operate as deposit-taking institutions in Vanuatu. Such EMIs may only serve as auxiliary payment gateways or card-issuing agents for fiat disbursements, provided the entity maintains a qualifying local licensing or agency arrangement under RBV payment-system rules. Mercury, Stripe Billing, and similar external rails are acceptable as collection and disbursement processors but not as substitutes for a regulated Vanuatu bank account when preserving IBC tax-exempt status.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) is conventionally required for the initial corporate account opening interview. Vanuatu licensed banks apply risk-based onboarding: a face-to-face meeting may be waived only when the beneficiary, director, or signatory holds an existing prime relationship with that bank or when the bank performs remote audio-video KYC under its own board-approved policy. Given the IBC is non-resident and low-risk standard, digitised video verification is increasingly accepted by tier-one banks but remains bank-specific. In all cases, at least one executive director or a designated corporate officer must undergo an enhanced due-diligence interview before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership of an International Company with nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate register transcript, full chain of legal ownership, UBO declaration through the licensed registered agent, board resolution authorising account opening, and signed fiduciary trust deed if nominee structures are used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue projected from cloud developer infrastructure located in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed geographic revenue model, IP address traffic breakdown, customer counterparty list, executed monitoring agreements, export licences if cryptography is involved, and a sanctions screening policy certified compliant with UN Security Council and local financial sanctions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from a third-country fintech or cryptocurrency exchange origin.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Verified source-of-funds statement certified by the transferring institution, monthly extract of the sending bank account, proof of commercial substance (hosting invoices, employee contracts, procurement contracts), and board-approved treasury policy confirming the business does not touch virtual-asset money-laundering flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity with low-margin developer subscription flows and frequent international wire payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed customer licence agreements, API usage logs triangulating subscription value, third-party payment-processor settlement evidence (Stripe and Mercury reconciliation), auditable billing record, and a written AML compliance manual with transaction monitoring thresholds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions must be structured as either equity or shareholder loan remittances via SWIFT MT103 through the IBC's Vanuatu operational bank account. The applicant shall use the harmonised purpose code for cross-border corporate investment (PURP: EQUI) and include a board resolution approving the capitalisation. Clearance of wires is accelerated when the sending parent entity's bank is a correspondent of the Vanuatu receiving bank and the reference line exactly matches the IBC's legal name. Capital escrow accounts will accept the injection and issue a certificate of deposit of share capital, preserving the IBC's exempt-tax status by avoiding any domestic trading through the registered agent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound vendor payments, infrastructure subscriptions, and software royalties settle via (1) SWIFT MT103 Cover or SWIFT MT103 direct credit for USD, AUD, NZD and EUR-denominated invoices; (2) commercial letters of credit (L/C) advised through a top-tier correspondent bank when disbursements exceed USD 250,000 and require documentary assurance; and (3) local vatu-denominated RTGS settlement for domestic Vanuatu contractor payments. The platform must include automatic generation of the UNSPSC invoice code and export tariff code for each disbursement to satisfy both Vanuatu and receiving-jurisdiction customs filings.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on VUV/USD entered with an eligible offshore bank because the vatu is non-deliverable outside Vanuatu.
Deliverable spot and outright forwards on USD/EUR/AUD conducted with RBV-licensed authorised foreign-exchange dealers.
Cross-currency basis swap on USD/AUD or USD/EUR for the conversion of subscription revenues to the IBC's functional treasury currency.
Vanuatu-exempt forward contracts under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a credit support annex and no speculative margin on the IBC balance sheet.
Currency options on USD/AUD combined with collar structures for budgeted non-functional-currency disbursements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VFSC Annual Renewal Return (International Company Annual Fee Payment and Compliance Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each annual anniversary of incorporation; the registered agent must remit the fee on or before that date. If the anniversary falls on a non-business day, payment is due on the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual fees accrue late penalties at 10% per month or part-month. A company in arrears for more than three months is subject to administrative strike-off by the VFSC; struck-off assets vest in the Government of Vanuatu and reinstatement requires payment of arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company. Statutory audit is required only if the company holds a VFSC-regulated financial services or securities licence, or if the shareholders pass a resolution requesting an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is the applicable reference framework where financial statements are voluntarily prepared. Vanuatu has no separate statutory local GAAP for International Companies, and no financial statements are required to be filed with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Companies are not required to file an annual UBO return with the VFSC. However, the registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership record and refresh it at least annually during renewal processing. Upon any transfer of shares, the Register of Members must be updated with the transferee details and the beneficial ownership record amended before registration of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 to USD 950 per year for a licensed registered agent and registered office in Port Vila
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not incurred absent shareholder or licensee requirement; if voluntarily commissioned under IFRS, approximately USD 4,000 to USD 9,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax law. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) is statutorily exempt from all income, profits, capital gains, and dividend taxation (ICA s.9).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effectively 0% on exported DevTools/cloud/API monitoring revenue. No CIT, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, no payroll tax for non-resident employees, and no exchange controls. The 12.5% VAT (Revenue (Value Added Tax) Act 1998) is zero-rated on exported services, so cross-border B2B SaaS, database infrastructure, and monitoring subscriptions sourced to non-residents bear 0% VAT. Residual burden consists only of VFSC registration fees and registered agent costs (typically USD 300–500 per annum).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return — International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), Schedule form; filed electronically through the VFSC Online Services portal (www.vfsc.vu) or via the registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the registration anniversary date (anniversary of incorporation); annual government continuation fee payable together with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Official IC name and unique VFSC registry number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as per Certificate of Incorporation; non-resident beneficial owners may be listed without VU tax consequences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the Vanuatu registered agent/office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a physical Vanuatu address; cannot be a PO Box; non-resident directors need not maintain a local office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full particulars of each director, secretary, and alternate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors permitted; passport and proof of address required for AML vetting by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder names, addresses, share classes, and holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident ownership allowed; nominee shareholders optional; bearer shares prohibited since VFSC policy updates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents or owned Vanuatu land.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Required to preserve the IC's offshore tax-exempt status; a false declaration triggers liability under ICA provisions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent attesting to compliance with the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be completed by the licensed VFSC agent; non-resident filers rely on the agent for attestation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-payment of the annual fee: monetary late penalty plus monthly surcharge, risk of administrative strike-off/deregistration, reinstatement requires court order and settlement of arrears; directors and officers may incur personal fines of up to VUV 100,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form VAT-100) under the Revenue (Value Added Tax) Act 1998, filed with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) through the online tax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly (calendar-quarterly for most taxpayers; monthly if prescribed by the Commissioner).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one calendar month after the end of the taxable period (e.g., quarterly return for Jan–Mar due by 30 April). Voluntary VAT registration applies above a VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover threshold; exported services are zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Output Tax on Taxable Supplies at 12.5%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total VAT charged on local standard-rated supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: DevTools infrastructure supplied to non-residents outside Vanuatu is zero-rated; do not include in Box 1.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of exported services, international services, and supplies benefiting a non-resident outside Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all B2B cloud API monitoring fees, database subscriptions, and platform charges billed to foreign clients (e.g., via Stripe Billing).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on local purchases and expenses attributable to taxable activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-hosted cloud costs bear no VU VAT and are non-creditable, but do not attract output VAT either.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output tax minus input tax; positive amount payable to VRC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export-only ICs typically claim a refund or file nil VAT; supporting contracts and bank evidence (Mercury ACH) must evidence foreign receipt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate consideration for all supplies in the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross worldwide subscription revenue to enable zero-rating audit trail.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corrections, credit notes, and bad debt relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign currency conversion to VUV using VRC exchange rates; chargeback reversals on Stripe billing should be recorded here.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded plus default interest; knowingly false returns constitute tax evasion punishable by fine and imprisonment up to 5 years; VRC may also impose a late filing penalty of VUV 1,000 per month or a similar fixed surcharge.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; the ICA s.9 exemption covenant guarantees freedom from dividend taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network, so no treaty-rate reclaim protocol exists. The practical procedure: (1) repatriate profits by board-authorised dividend resolution; (2) effect transfer via customary banking channels (Stripe Billing to the IC's operating account, then wire/ACH via Mercury) without VU WHT or exchange control approval; (3) where a shareholder must evidence tax-exempt status abroad, obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency / Certificate of Non-Residence from the VFSC attesting to the IC's Vanuatu incorporation and nil-tax liability; (4) retain dividend minutes and transfer records for the source jurisdiction's inspection.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% on outbound and inbound royalties for IP, software, API, and database licensing; statutory rate 0% on inbound and outbound debt interest. Treaty rate: N/A (no DTA). Vanuatu does not tax non-residents on Vanuatu-source passive income and does not tax IC income at all, making cross-border IP royalty flows and intercompany loans entirely free of domestic withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory TP documentation threshold is codified in Vanuatu law (no CIT/TP legislation). Adoption of OECD-aligned Master File/Local File documentation is strongly recommended where annual related-party transactions (licensing, intercompany services, cloud infrastructure) exceed VUV 50,000,000 (approximately USD 420,000), or where the related-party royalty/income ratio exceeds 30% of gross revenue, to support economic substance filings and defend against foreign CFC/treaty-shopping challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 applies to ICs carrying on 'relevant activities,' which include an Intellectual Property Business and a Distribution and Service Centre business — both engaged by a DevTools software, database, and API monitoring group. For each applicable activity, the IC must: (1) be managed and directed from Vanuatu (quorum of board meetings physically in Vanuatu, minutes retained, strategic decisions made there); (2) maintain adequate physical premises, qualified full-time employees, and operating expenditure proportionate to the level of activity; (3) perform core income-generating activities (contract negotiation, pricing, pipeline management, monitoring dashboard support) in Vanuatu; (4) file an annual economic substance return with the VFSC. Failure to satisfy ESR exposes the IC to penalties and potential deregistration, undermining the viability of a pure 'invoice shell' model.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false VAT returns, underdeclaring local-standard-rated supplies, or overclaiming zero-rating on services that are in fact performed/consumed in Vanuatu; deliberate document destruction to hide local-source DevTools revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of up to 150% of the evaded tax plus interest; criminal fine of up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years under the Revenue (Value Added Tax) Act 1998; VRC may recompute the VAT assessment and enforce asset seizure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise false returns are jointly and severally liable for civil penalties; conviction carries imprisonment, disqualification from managing companies in Vanuatu, and a travel ban pending criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure invoice platform with no Vanuatu physical presence, board meetings held entirely abroad, no local employees or expenditure, and failure to file the mandatory ESR return — while claiming foreign 'zero-tax' status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019: immediate penalty of VUV 2,000,000 for failure to file the ESR return, escalating VUV 1,000,000 per month for continuing non-compliance, up to VUV 10,000,000 for supplying false information; ultimate deregistration and striking-off of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined up to VUV 1,000,000, disqualified as officers, and subjected to a travel ban; third-party creditors can pierce the corporate veil where the IC is found to be a sham, rendering directors personally liable for company debts and contractual restitutions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to implement a risk-based AML/CFT program, refusing to conduct CDD on beneficial owners, failing to report suspicious transactions, or knowingly accepting illicit proceeds through subscription payment rails (Stripe Billing) or ACH transfers (Mercury).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017: corporate fines up to VUV 50,000,000, confiscation of funds, suspension of VFSC licence; involved individuals face imprisonment up to 15 years and fines up to VUV 25,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for AML offences committed with their knowledge or consent; sanctions include imprisonment, asset freezing, travel bans, and personal financial penalties, in addition to indefinite disqualification from holding position in a VFSC-regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to Foreign Tax Authorities / CRS Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Asserting Vanuatu tax residence to foreign tax administrators while actual management and control remain in the shareholder's home country; failing to comply with the CRS due diligence and automatic exchange of information obligations under the Tax Administration (Common Reporting Standard) Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UK/US/Source-country anti-abuse rules and the VFSC CRS enforcement regime impose fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and administrative orders to correct disclosures; the foreign jurisdiction may treat the IC as tax-resident under CFC/management-and-control rules, back-taxing 20–30% of profits with interest and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false residence declarations face prosecution for perjury in the source jurisdiction, personal assessment for unpaid corporate taxes under contractual indemnity, exclusion from cross-border banking partnerships, and criminal extradition in egregious fraud cases.
